title: Chaos in the symmetric ABC flow
plain: The ABC flow with all three coefficients equal to 1 is a classical steady solution of the Euler equations on the 3-torus. Prove it is genuinely chaotic.
math: Prove that the flow of $\dot x=\sin z+\cos y,\ \dot y=\sin x+\cos z,\ \dot z=\sin y+\cos x$ on $\mathbb T^3$ has positive topological entropy.
